aiOverview.content: In the 500th episode of NCIS ("All Good Things," Season 23, Episode 13, aired March 24, 2026), Director Leon Vance (played by Rocky Carroll) was killed in the line of duty. After discovering CID Agent Dolan Thompson was corrupt, Vance was shot multiple times in the chest by him while trying to save the NCIS agency. Key Details of Director Vance's Death: The Killer: CID Agent Dolan Thompson, who was revealed to be working against the agency. The Cause: Shot multiple times in the chest during a confrontation, with agents Parker and McGee arriving too late to save him. The Sacrifice: Vance died protecting the agency from being shut down, with showrunner Steven D. Binder emphasizing the death was a heroic sacrifice. Afterlife Scene: Following his death, Vance was welcomed into the afterlife by a vision of a young Dr. Ducky Mallard. Final Appearance: This marked the end of Rocky Carroll's 18-season run as a series regular on the show. The death occurred during a milestone episode designed to shake up the series and create high stakes in its 23rd season.
